restaurant_name: คลินิกเวชกรรมงามเจริญ
text: Requesting a referral takes all day. Requesting a medical certificate costs 200 baht and takes 5 minutes. Is this right? Thailand's healthcare system is deteriorating day by day.

restaurant_name: คลินิกเวชกรรมงามเจริญ
text: The service was terrible. The doctor spoke rudely and didn't even know the patient's illness well, but said he would send me to the hospital that referred me. He said that the hospital already had a doctor who specialized in this field. When I actually went to see him, there was no specialist, which meant I was wasting money on travel and waiting for nothing. It took a long time to get a referral letter, even though there weren't many people. I had to wait at least 2 hours.

restaurant_name: คลินิกเวชกรรมงามเจริญ
text:
I had COVID-19 and paid almost 700 baht for a medical certificate, but the medication I received wasn't appropriate for my condition. I don't understand why they gave me amoxicillin; it's an antibacterial drug, and COVID-19 is a virus. Amoxicillin cannot treat COVID-19. The other medications were all basic drugs: Paracetamol, CPM, Bromhexine, and ORS. Importantly, I didn't even get to see a doctor. I waited outside for about 30 minutes before being called to pick up my medication. The staff at the counter weren't very polite either.

In summary, in my opinion, the service and the medication I received weren't worth the cost of treatment.

restaurant_name: คลินิกเวชกรรมงามเจริญ
text: The way she answered my questions was unpleasant and rude. Her facial expression and demeanor were unprofessional, but not towards me; it was different for other people who came to ask questions. The nurse at the counter was being aggressive and dismissive, her tone and demeanor completely mismatched with her appearance. She seemed intimidating and pushy, sometimes speaking nicely, sometimes not. She spoke moderately to those who were well-dressed, and when asked too many questions, she would say she had already answered, but later customers didn't know. It seemed she wasn't a real nurse, possibly a trainee, a student, or even someone who hadn't studied nursing at all. Her attitude and the service were terrible. While the answers given were correct, the tone was unacceptable—harsh, cruel, and frightening.
author_name: กชกร ทําขวัญ

restaurant_name: คลินิกเวชกรรมงามเจริญ
text: A nice place and a good clinic are definitely needed for the community, but if the staff or personnel at the clinic are not good, it's not okay. I'd like to see improvement in how you communicate and answer questions. Sometimes people asking questions don't know your workflow. Don't answer as if you know everything; otherwise, you'd be the clinic owner! I understand you're stressed and tired from work, but in a service job, at least think a little. People who come for service don't want to hear negative things you say. If you're tired of this job, quit and do something else. Coordination is also important; please communicate and consult with each other so that work doesn't turn out so badly. P.S. Yes, some people may be receiving free services, but they shouldn't have to experience this kind of thing.

restaurant_name: คลินิกเวชกรรมงามเจริญ
